10xteam.board_introduction_html:
At 10x, there are two types of opportunities:

1. Traditional freelance missions
These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on.

2. AI Lab roles
For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities.

The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent.

Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise.

This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.
10xteam.name: 10x Team

aios.board_introduction_html:
AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about the company here: https://aiosmedical.notion.site/
aios.name: AIOS

ashby.board_introduction_html:
Where we're coming from

Abhik and I started Ashby for two reasons.

First, we wanted to equip people & talent teams with much more powerful tools - matching the strategic importance these functions have for modern businesses.

Just as importantly, we wanted to build a world-class organization that delivers excellent products and customer experiences and constantly challenges the status quo.

This ambition spans every function: we’re known for our best in class product velocity (powered by an excellent and uniquely organized Engineering team). At the same time our customers view our Customer Success & Sales experience as a huge differentiator. We care deeply about making all touch points with the Ashby brand & people excellent - and we’re investing in the talent to make that possible.


Growth to date & what’s next

Having publicly launched in late 2022, we now serve over 5,000 global customers. We’re delivering top decile metrics across growth rates, retention & efficiency. All of our customer segments are experiencing rapid growth. We’re the default for new startups - and are rapidly growing our Enterprise segment as well. There’s a lot of organic love for what we’ve built.

We’re now entering our next phase of exciting growth by becoming a true multi-product company. As much as we’ve achieved significant scale, we’re still attracting builders and there’s a ton of exciting work ahead of us.

There’s a common belief that companies slow down as they scale. That they stop innovating. Become “political”. As much as Ashby is about solving the most important problems our customers face, it’s also about defying gravity when it comes to building a successful business.

Our operating principles (next section) are a big part of what have allowed us to deliver on both fronts in recent years.

How we work & what we value

We have published our operating principles on our blog - they describe how we work at Ashby. They cover how we aim to run projects, spend time and make decisions.

Beyond that we also look for specific attributes in new hires. Folks at Ashby are generally described as:

  • Humble and Empathetic

  • Curious

  • Driven

  • Reliable

  • Transparent and Honest

  • Don't Take Themselves Too-Seriously

You can read more about the "why" behind these attributes in the same blog post.
ashby.name: Ashby

causaprima.board_introduction_html:
Build the Future of Finance

Every year, $90 trillion moves between businesses — managed through duct-taped workflows, manual data entry, and spreadsheets. 68% of companies still key invoice data by hand. Trillions sit trapped as dead working capital.

Causa Prima is building the first agentic AI network for finance operations. Autonomous agents that don't just automate tasks — they negotiate across company boundaries, resolve disputes in real-time, and make financial decisions with real judgment. Not another dashboard. Not another workflow tool. A system that acts.

The real unlock is what happens at scale: every company that joins makes the network smarter. Agents negotiate with each other across the supply chain. A context graph captures the why behind every financial decision — creating a compounding data moat no competitor can replicate.

Why Join Us

🏗️ Ground floor of a category-defining company You won't maintain someone else's codebase. You'll make foundational decisions that shape the product, the architecture, and the culture for years to come.

🧠 World-class founders Three founders with complementary strengths across supply chain finance (Taulia — acquired by SAP), tokenization infrastructure (Centrifuge), and security-first fintech architecture (Oak Security, Finoa). Together: 10 startups, $400M+ raised, $bn of assets under management, 2 unicorns built.

🌱 Backed by the best $30M raised in the first six months ($10M pre-seed, $20M seed) from Base10, QED, Creandum and K Fund.

💎 Meaningful equity, not token grants All employees receive generous equity We believe in real ownership for the people who take the earliest risk.

⚡ Build with the best tools TypeScript · Python · LangGraph · LlamaIndex · Neo4j · PostgreSQL · Redis · React — chosen for the problems we're solving, not for trend-following.

📍 Madrid & Munich We believe the best early-stage work happens in person. Our hubs are in Madrid and Munich, with regular travel between the two.

What we offer beyond salary and equity


Health & wellness. Private health insurance via Alan for Spain-based hires (100% company-paid). ClassPass subscription for everyone, from gym access to back massages.
Everyday life covered. Pre-tax food and transport stipends in Spain via Alan Flex. Pre-tax food stipend in Germany. Deutschlandticket Job 100% covered for the Munich team.
Growth on us. L&D budget for courses, books, conferences, or certifications. Weekly English coaching sessions with a dedicated coach.
Welcome package. Noise-cancelling headphones and plenty of Causa Prima swag on day one.

  • We will never request personal financial information (such as bank account details) during the initial application or interview process.
  • Our hiring process does not involve transferring money or making payments of any kind to secure a position.

Amplemarket is not responsible for any loss or damage incurred as a result of job scams or fraudulent activity by third parties misusing our company name.

If you have any doubts about the legitimacy of a job opportunity with Amplemarket, please contact our HR department directly.

We advise you to verify the authenticity of any job-related communications claiming to be from Amplemarket. If you have any concerns or doubts, please contact us directly through our official channels.

Your security is our priority. Thank you for your vigilance and understanding.

greenhouse:hellofresh.board_introduction_html:
HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit company. In Q1 2020 alone we provided 111 million meals to 4.2 million households worldwide in 14 countries across 3 continents. 

HelloFresh supplies everything you need to prepare quality, delicious, home-cooked meals that require no planning, no shopping and no hassle. Every ingredient needed for our thousands of exclusive recipes is carefully planned, responsibly sourced and delivered to your door when it’s most convenient for you. Only HelloFresh gives you the tools to achieve something delicious every day.

Making dinner a delicious achievement – not just another meal – takes a lot of work and smart people. From Designers and Copywriters to Data Scientists and DevOps Engineers, to potato farmers, pasta makers and the people who ensure every box is perfectly packed for every customer, we’re collectively disrupting the food supply chain and the multi-trillion-dollar food tech industry.

Our offices across the globe from New York to Berlin, London to Sydney are filled with more than 7,000 high-performing and ambitious talents from over 70 countries. We’re always looking for new ingredients to spice up our recipe, so join us now!

Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Important Note:

It has come to our attention that scammers impersonating Phiture have contacted private individuals, offering jobs in exchange for money. Please DO NOT under any circumstances engage with any website claiming to be Phiture that is not our official domain, phiture.com, or with an email that is not from @phiture.com. If you have any doubts, please contact us via our website to verify the authenticity of a request or communication. We do not offer jobs via WhatsApp, Skype, or other social media channels, and we do not require a cash deposit for anyone to work for us.

greenhouse:speechify.board_introduction_html:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. 

 

Over 30 million people use Speechify’s text to speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more.

  • 150+ years of audio are consumed every month on Speechify
  • Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year
  • Apple has recognized Speechify's iOS app as its winner of 2025's Inclusivity Award
  • Top #20 app in the App Store for Productivity

 

Speechify also provides a voice-over, voice cloning, and dubbing studio for businesses and creators and a text-to-speech API for developers. Through its products, Speechify is the largest provider of Speech AI in the world.

 

Some of our tech stack includes: Swift, Kotlin, React, Typescript (frontend), NodeJS, Go (backend), and Python (AI). 

 

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. Everyone is expected by be hands-on with passion and desire to deliver excellent work. 

 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

 

Background: Cliff Weitzman founded Speechify to overcome his own dyslexia. Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, Netflix, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Revolut, Stripe, and Bolt, and many founders of their own companies. Excited to meet you!

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need - and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across Musculoskeletal, Women’s Health, Cardiometabolic, and Mental Health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 1 million members across three continents have completed over 15 million AI sessions, helping 2,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 59 clinical studies, 43 patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

Driven by Artificial Intelligence, Xometry [pronounced with a /z/ ] is empowering our customers to build parts that are critical components in next-generation industries from spacecraft and electric vehicles to medical devices and robotics. Our digital marketplace and suite of cloud-based solutions are enabling the long tail of the internet to finally reach the thousands of small- and medium-sized manufacturers in the United States and around the world.

Xometry is a two sided, AI enabled marketplace connecting businesses with optimal manufacturing solutions. Customers ranging from startups to Fortune 100 companies can simply go to Xometry.com, upload a 3D CAD file of a part they need manufactured and receive an instant-quote with the cost and time to make and ship the part. Orders can be checked out right then and there in less than 10 minutes without having to interface with any manufacturer. This technology is unprecedented in an industry where, traditionally, you would reach out and request quotes from several manufacturers taking days if not weeks to get your parts ordered.

 

Here at Xometry, we are a leading company in On Demand Manufacturing. We are in a hyper-growth phase, with a manufacturing platform that is loved and used by customers around the world.  If you're dedicated and ambitious, Xometry is an excellent place to grow your career.

kota.board_introduction_html:
At Kota, our Mission is to make employee benefits accessible, valued and global, because right now there are hundreds of millions of people who don’t get access to basic benefits like retirement or healthcare, because they’re fundamentally broken, outdated and inadequate. They live offline, gate kept by old-school insurance companies and brokers, who don’t know how modern employees work, and are not capable of building the future we’re living in order to help them access and understand what that extra 15% of their compensation is. 

Ultimately, if we succeed our Vision will see us become the internet infrastructure for financial benefits, where a generation accesses and understands the key pillars of their compensation. Their Health Insurance plan and what it covers, the retirement plan they can easily, or understand the life insurance cover that is crucial for their family. 

We power the benefits companies should offer their people. It's a responsibility we never take lightly—supporting employees through illness, loss, or retirement demands unwavering trust and care. Our values are at the heart of everything we build.

If we want to go far, we have to go together. To do that we need to have a group of people with shared  Values. At Kota, here’s what we live by:

  • Have Integrity: We care deeply about our why and it won’t jeopardise our how.

  • Care deeply: Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own your ship: Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar: We continuously look to push past good enough—expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team’s standards.

  • Play to win: We exist because we decided to say no to the norm – now we do this everyday.

Today, we power benefits for hundreds of companies and tens of thousands of employees from some of the most exciting and progressive employers in Europe, like Carwow, Tines, Zoe, Remote, and many more.

litmus.board_introduction_html:
About Litmus

Litmus is the modern industrial edge data platform that provides the complete data foundation required to operationalize AI at scale across manufacturing enterprises. Purpose-built for complex OT environments, Litmus connects to heterogeneous industrial assets and systems, normalizes and contextualizes data at the edge, and enforces consistent governance across plants to deliver enterprise-ready data pipelines for analytics and AI.

Beyond connectivity, Litmus enables Industrial DataOps by providing tools to model, version, manage, and govern data consistently across sites. Centralized management capabilities allow organizations to deploy configurations, data models, and AI workloads repeatably across dozens or hundreds of facilities, preventing one-off implementations from becoming operational debt. This standardized approach supports scalable use cases such as OEE optimization, predictive maintenance, quality analytics, energy management, and real-time operational intelligence.

mento.board_introduction_html:
About Mento

Mento is a performance coaching platform on a mission to increase human potential at global scale and help people — and companies — grow.


We believe coaching is one of the most powerful ways to unlock meaningful professional growth. We also believe the future of coaching is human + AI: deeply human where trust, judgment, and connection matter most, and intelligently augmented where technology can make coaching more measurable, actionable, and scalable.


Mento pairs leaders with top operators in their field for 1:1 coaching and mentorship, supported by Moments, our AI intelligence layer that turns coaching into real-time insight.


Our customers include Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, 1Password, Brex, Whatnot, Gusto, and Hims & Hers. We’re backed by leading investors including Slow Ventures, M13, and Twelve Below.

Why Work with Us?

At Mento, we’re dedicated to helping professionals build meaningful careers—starting with our own culture.

We’re an ambitious, collaborative, growth-minded team working to make a real impact while having fun along the way. As an early-stage company, every team member plays a critical role in shaping our product, culture, and user experience.

We value diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. If you’re passionate about helping more people access meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you.

oviva.board_introduction_html:
Join our journey

Oviva is Europe’s leading digital health provider for weight-related conditions. We make this care accessible to everyone who needs it – reimbursed, at scale, and proven.

Founded in 2014 by Kai Eberhardt and Manuel Baumann, we’ve significantly improved the lives of more than 1 million patients across Germany, the UK, and Switzerland, backed by 100+ peer-reviewed publications.

Our AI-enabled care combines a medical-device-certified app with clinical teams of doctors, dietitian's, and behavioural specialists: reimbursed as a certified DiGA in Germany, in partnership with the NHS in the UK, and integrated into Swiss public healthcare. We treat obesity, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes, expanding further to become the long-term partner for chronic care in Europe.

Our mission: To build a healthier future for all, our mission is to provide the most accessible and effective care to people living with weight-related conditions

Why? Patients live healthier lives. Health systems become more sustainable. Societies remain healthier and more productive. We prove it by rigorously measuring and publishing our outcomes.

At Qdrant, how we build is just as important as what we build.

We’re creating the infrastructure that allows AI to search, retrieve, and reason over data in a meaningful way - turning raw information into something systems can actually use. From semantic search to retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents, the next generation of software depends on fast, reliable, and scalable vector search. That’s where we come in.

But this isn’t just about technology.

We’re a fully remote, async-first team built around focus and autonomy. We keep meetings to a minimum and trust people to manage their time and priorities. We welcome you to a culture of trust, high standards, and meaningful output.

As an open-source company, we stay close to the people who use what we create. Many of our best ideas come from real-world problems. We iterate quickly, ship often, and focus on solving things that actually matter.

We’re still early in this space, and that’s part of the appeal. There’s real opportunity to shape not just the product, but how this category evolves.

If you’re looking for work with ownership, depth, and long-term impact - we are looking forward to meeting you.

somnia.board_introduction_html:
Somnia is the Agentic L1 - a hyper-performance, fully EVM-compatible Layer 1 built for agents and ral-time applications that can’t exist on traditional chains.⁠ With over 1M TPS, sub-second finality, and sub-cent fees, Somnia is designed so builders can stop engineering around latency and throughput limits and instead ship responsive, always-on onchain systems.⁠

What makes Somnia “agentic” is that smart contracts can do more than execute isolated onchain logic: Somnia Agents let contracts natively query any API, scrape websites, and run deterministic LLM inference, with results validated by a decentralized subset of validators and accompanied by execution receipts for auditability.⁠

⁠On top of this infrastructure, we’re shipping flagship products that prove the thesis: dreamDEX, a fully onchain CLOB designed for professional capital with CEX-grade execution and native agent/algo access,⁠and Prophecy / Prophecy Social, an AI-native prediction markets stack where markets can run live and resolve autonomously AI via Somnia Agents.⁠

We are a fully remote, global team united by a shared vision of an onchain future.
